column3: They stand according to Your ordinances today; the ordinances are not the grammatical subject.
Your commandment is very broad, rather than explicitly without limit.
After plural commandments, the clause uses singular “it is mine forever.”
The palate and mouth are named separately; the word is singular.
The hating is expressed as completed.
The offerings are called voluntary gifts without an explicit sacrificial noun.
My soul is in my palm, singular; no verb of taking occurs.
Taking the testimonies as an inheritance is an explicit completed action.
Both hating and loving are expressed as completed.
The rejecting is expressed as completed; their deceit is falsehood.
Discarding and loving are expressed as completed.
Both shuddering and fearing are expressed as completed.
